To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Saudi women have inadequate knowledge about breast cancer and inappropriate attitudes toward the disease and that this knowledge deficit and inappropriate attitude are independently associated with suboptimal breast cancer screening practices among Saudi females.
the majority of women in Riyadh are not performing breast self examination and mammography.
Breast cancer is the most prevalent malignancy in women in the Kingdom of Arabia.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model for the design of an effective breast cancer screening program in Saudi Arabia.
the development of a model to predict the probability of a patient having breast cancer.
the development of a new methodology for studying breast cancer screening practices among Saudi females.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Saudi women's knowledge about breast cancer is inadequate, their attitudes are inappropriate and their breast cancer screening practices are suboptimal.
Saudi women have inadequate knowledge, inappropriate attitudes and suboptimal practices towards breast cancer.

there is a need for a well designed and implemented educational campaign to improve the knowledge of the population about the risk of breast cancer and to encourage them to practice breast self examination and to undergo screening mammography.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
breast cancer is a major health problem in the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia, and that the incidence is rising.
the study findings indicate significant inadequacy in knowledge, inappropriate attitudes towards breast cancer and suboptimal screening behaviors among Saudi women.
breast cancer screening is not a priority for the majority of Saudi women.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a great need to improve knowledge, attitude and practice about breast cancer among Saudi women.
breast cancer screening should be promoted among Saudi females and that this promotion should be targeted at young women.
the Saudi government should invest more resources into the education and awareness of women in Saudi Arabia.
